productRules: Every phase has two materially active roles.
Earlier camp/player state changes visible aspects of the storm.
Failure is mostly fail-forward and does not erase all progress.
Interaction grammar reuses already learned interactions.
Partner speech remains higher priority than storm audio/music.

phase3Randomness.rule: Prefer earned consequence over arbitrary random complication; no final numeric probability before human fairness evidence.

sharedHeavyObject.rule: Phase 4 depends on the shared-object proof; contract does not claim runtime viability.

roles.intent: Hold beam/tarp structure in a broad safe zone and react to gust/structure movement.
Secure rope points and repair a visible loose/damaged node.

phases.failForward: Missed binds can worsen shelter/time/fatigue, but phase advances after functional minimum.

phases.purpose: Split attention between protecting recoverable fire and adding dry fuel.

roles.intent: Shield recoverable flame/embers from wind and rain.
Retrieve one bounded dry-fuel load and add it when partner signals readiness.

phases.failForward: Weak fire adds recovery work but stays recoverable; no unrelated new interaction grammar.

phases.purpose: Return an earlier choice in a causally legible way.

roles.intent: Branch-specific active role; must materially affect recovery.
Second materially active branch-specific role; no passive waiting role.

phases.failForward: Consequence may consume time/worsen state; no surprise scenario loss from one hidden roll.

phases.purpose: Peak physical cooperation by reusing the heavy-object grammar.

roles.intent: Take one side/target of the critical beam/structure.
Take the second side/target; stabilization requires both players.

phases.failForward: Grip mistakes do not cause a long reset; functional repair locks once minimum shared stabilization succeeds.

phases.purpose: Turn survival into joint rescue and pay off prior signal preparation.

roles.intent: Carry/protect viable ember/fire source through final placement.
Prepare signal point and receive/place fuel or activate final structure.

phases.failForward: Weak preparation increases setup/pressure but does not remove the right to attempt rescue.

steps: players get a short shared look-at-camp/partner beat
epilogue/personalization opens without instant menu cut

loss.retryIntent: pre-storm checkpoint or later approved checkpoint; never whole-scenario mandatory replay
